entries.aec174c83eb571e4: This business sells women's lingerie for body shaping (foundations and lingerie), body care cosmetics, custom-made insoles and dedicated shoes, and original supplements and health foods, through directly operated stores nationwide and EC sites. Directly operated stores also provide after-service such as body making using women's lingerie. Marco Co., Ltd., the core subsidiary, is responsible for it, and the non-consolidated subsidiary Maluke'er (Shanghai) International Trade Co., Ltd. sells women's lingerie and related products in China under agency contracts with local companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,589 million.

entries.fa52f6fd032bcc5f: The Women's Underwear and Related Businesses is the core business, with revenue from external customers of ¥18,589 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue. It sells body-shaping women's underwear through directly operated stores nationwide and EC sites, and at directly operated stores it provides after-sales services such as body making even after products are supplied, maintaining relationships with customers that continue after purchase. In the current fiscal year, the purchase unit price of existing customers rose owing to factors such as the introduction of new colors in its main product series, and the business recorded an increase in revenue.
